canonical_project: River Bend AI Data Center Campus

history.old_value: announced; utility capacity secured; first phase leased
history.reason: Hut 8 Q2 2026 results and current River Bend page report the campus/facilities as under construction; West Feliciana Parish page says the AI facility is being constructed.
Latest primary company result explicitly updates River Bend construction status.

why_not_in_baseline: Not among the 208 canonical_project names; announced after the baseline freeze as a Louisiana AI campus with Entergy-supported utility capacity for Fluidstack/Anthropic workloads.
contradictions: Capacity figures are non-additive: Hut 8 reports 330 MW utility capacity and 245 MW commercialized IT capacity, plus up to 1,000 MW potential expansion capacity subject to power expansion. Earlier/local-media references to 300 MW or $2.5B appear to predate the December 2025 Phase I/lease disclosure and are not used as the current controlling capacity.
